column3: “It was displeasing to Jonah a great displeasure” is rendered “it greatly displeased Jonah”; “it burned to him” is rendered “he became angry.”
“I beg you” is rendered “Please”; “I did the first time to flee” is rendered “in order to forestall this I fled,” and “covenant loyalty” “lovingkindness.”
“Does it rightly burn to you?” is rendered “Do you have good reason to be angry?”
“From east of the city” is rendered “east of it.”
“Distress” is rendered “discomfort”; “rejoiced a great joy” is rendered “was extremely happy.”
“A hot east wind” is rendered “a scorching east wind,” and “struck” “beat down”; “asked his life to die” is rendered “begged with all his soul to die.”
“Rightly it burns to me to death” is rendered “I have good reason to be angry, even to death.”
“A son of a night” is rendered “overnight.”
“Two plus ten ten thousand” is rendered as a number; “distinguishes between his right and his left” is rendered “know the difference between their right and left hand.”
